fact: On 23 September 2026 the Monetary and Banking Council authorised Djezzy Payment Services, a telecom subsidiary, to incorporate as a payment service provider under Bank of Algeria Regulation 25-02 of April 2025, which lets non-banks apply; it is not yet licensed to operate.
title: Paiement numérique : l'ouverture aux PSP pour accélérer la sortie du tout-cash en Algérie
